answers.reason: The senate deals with university-wide statutes and strategy, whereas every member only takes part in the one place where their specific matters are decided.
The budget planning round is for university-wide fund allocation, which falls outside the full professor's single faculty body.
The appointment committee handles vacant professorships, while the full professor participates only in their single main decision body.
The full professor holds a chair in the faculty, making the faculty council the one place where their faculty affairs are decided.
Members only sit in one body, and the study commission handles specific degree programme preparations rather than the general faculty affairs of a chair holder.
The examination board deals with individual student examination matters, not the matters of a full professor.
The internal research funding round awards small grants and is separate from the single body where a full professor's core faculty matters are decided.
The module revision working group handles specific module descriptions, and members do not sit in multiple bodies.
The laboratory equipment procurement handles a specific purchasing task outside the full professor's single designated body.
Orientation week planning is for new students and not the one body where the full professor's matters are decided.
